thread:
ana_support: Customer escalation — started seeing 502/504s after TLS cert rollover in eu-west. Customer says streaming endpoints fail intermittently, long tail ~5-10s and then 502. Trace ids: t-cc3a, t-cc3b. Can we triage?

mike_sre: grabbing traces now, any curl repro?

ana_support: attaching minimal repro and envoy log snippet.

curl command:
```
curl -v --http2 "https://api.redwood-eu.example.com/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":10}'
```

Response:
```
* Connection state changed (HTTP/2 confirmed)
< HTTP/2 502
< content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream reset: HTTP/2 stream error"}
```

Envoy log (ingress-12):
```
[2026-03-16T14:12:02Z] upstream reset: HTTP/2 stream error, reason=FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR
[2026-03-16T14:12:02Z] TLS session resumed failed: no session found
```

mike_sre: :eyes: That flow control error + TLS resume fail is interesting. Are we seeing increased connection churn around the rollover?

dina_runtime: saw similar in canary last night during cert swap when clients retried with http2. Hypothesis: TLS session resumption mismatch triggers quick reconnects; h2 connection window gets out of sync causing FLOW_CONTROL errors. Workaround: force downgrade to http/1.1 per route or increase h2 window and keepalive.

kevin_prod: customer can't change client. Need mitigation on our side asap. Could we enable HTTP/1.1 fallback for that VIP?

dina_runtime: Yes. Quick patch: set route to prefer http/1.1 and disable h2 for the route -> restart envoy (rolling) on eu nodes. Also suggested adjusting envoy setting: h2_stream_window 65535 -> 1048576 and extend keepalive timeout to 120s.

mike_sre: I'll open a rolling-restart job on eu-tier and flip route to http/1.1 for affected VIP. Deploy bot will post status.

deploy-bot: Started job r-job-4523: rolling restart eu-ingress cluster (nodes 3/10 restarted). ETA ~6m.

ana_support: notified customer of mitigation and asked for results.

customer_success_jamie: customer reports reduced 502s after ~4m, still occasional 1/1000. They'll keep us posted.

dina_runtime: followup: we'll schedule a config change to increase h2 window and keepalive for next maintenance window. Also add a short-term rule to prefer http/1.1 for streaming endpoints during cert swaps.

mike_sre: closing initial escalation, creating follow-up ticket to instrument session-resume metrics. t-cc3a and t-cc3b retained.

ana_support: thanks all. :thumbsup:
